metadata.description: Unofficial Claude Certification study plugins: adaptive quizzes, timed mock exams, concept explainers, flashcard drills, and contributor authoring tools. Not affiliated with Anthropic.

plugins.name: exam-coach
plugins.description: Interactive tutor: adaptive /quiz-me, timed /mock-exam (100–1000 scale), /explain-concept, and /grade-my-answer. Bundled question banks for all four tracks.

plugins.name: flashcard-drill
plugins.description: Terminal Leitner-style flashcard drilling for any Anthropic University track, with domain filters and weak-card requeues.

plugins.name: cert-author
plugins.description: Contributor toolkit: author original docs-grounded questions, adversarially review a bank, and rebuild generated content.
